_what_this_is: The formal C3 nine-probe measurement authorized by the maintainer decision of 2026-09-30. All nine probes were trained, preserved AND scored; both frozen digest gates passed; the evaluation field is protocol-uniform. Stage I -- the aggregation that applies the frozen decision rule -- then raised before writing c3_decision.json. The MEASUREMENT is complete and durable; what the session did not produce on the pod is the decision artifact.
_terminal_label_is_wrong_and_why: The driver writes its markers to /workspace/autoinit_c3.status while the launcher polls /workspace/autoinit_c1.status, so no driver marker -- including a terminal one -- can reach the launcher's detector and the session is classified by exit code. attempt66 carries the same artefact (DRIVER_EXITED:40). A mid-run mirror made the markers visible for supervision, which is how the acquisition loop correctly stopped instead of launching a second formal attempt; the source fix is owed.
